description: This file appears to be a shell script used for testing Git commands related to checkout behavior, especially in detached HEAD states. It contains functions, test cases, and output expectations for various checkout scenarios.

methods.name: check_detached
methods.description: Checks if the current HEAD is in a detached state, expecting the symbolic-ref command to fail.

methods.name: check_not_detached
methods.description: Checks if the current HEAD is not detached, expecting the symbolic-ref command to succeed.

methods.name: check_orphan_warning
methods.description: Verifies if the output contains a warning about leaving orphan commits behind.

methods.name: check_no_orphan_warning
methods.description: Verifies that there are no orphan warning messages in the output.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the repository to branch 'main' and verifies it's not detached.
